offering_description.value: The company sells turf and landscape equipment, snow and ice management equipment, underground utility and specialty construction equipment, and irrigation and outdoor lighting systems. It serves contractors, golf courses, groundskeepers, growers, rental companies, public and educational institutions, sports venues, historic sites and homeowners. Its products reach customers through distributors, dealers, rental stores and retailers.

quotes.quote: With roots The Toro Company was built on a tradition of quality and caring relationships. Today, the company is a leading worldwide provider of innovative solutions for the outdoor environment including turf and landscape maintenance, snow and ice management, underground utility construction, rental and specialty construction, and irrigation and outdoor lighting solutions. Through a strong network of professional distributors, dealers, rental stores and retailers in multiple countries, we proudly offer a wide range of products across a family of global brands to help golf courses, professional contractors, underground construction professionals, groundskeepers, agricultural growers, rental companies, government and educational institutions, and homeowners – in addition to many leading sports venues and historic sites around the world.
